title: Ah non partite!
subtitle: Ferrando, Guglielmo, Don Alfonso, Dorabella and Fiordiligi: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 1

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 11, recitative after No. 14
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (Guglielmo's babara, a misprint for barbara; degl' occhi as two words; a voi davanti, where the libretto has o a voi davanti).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 120–121, the recitative between No. 14 and No. 15 (23 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers (the two piano readings were identical), every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words (bars 7, 10 and 21), the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. Kept as printed: Guglielmo's “ba - ba-ra” in bar 2. It ends “segue Nr. 15”. Playback tempo ♩ = 81, a speaking pace for secco recitative, from Jacobs (1:08); Mozart gives no tempo.

licences.source: Written for this app (from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts)
